result.title: ATEMPO: Amortized Transfer Entropy Model Per-lag Over-Time
result.summary: When one time series informs another, the delay at which that information arrives determines if models can utilize this relationship effectively. A source may be strongly predictive at one delay but uninformative at neighboring lags. Therefore, fixed input windows may obscure this structure by bundling informative and irrelevant history together. Transfer entropy (TE) can recover these delays by measuring how much a source's past tells us about a target beyond the target's own history. However, existing TE estimators require separate fits across source and conditioning depths, with further estimation on local windows to track delays over time. We introduce ATEMPO, a diffusion-based transfer entropy estimator amortized over lags and time. ATEMPO samples source and conditioning depths during training and conditions explicitly on temporal position, allowing a single score network to estimate the full TE surface without refitting. Differencing this surface recovers when information arrives. Across synthetic datasets with ground-truth TE, ATEMPO achieves the lowest mean relative error among baselines, and on datasets with known lags, ATEMPO achieves $0.98\pm0.04$ lag-detection accuracy. ATEMPO requires a single fit across source depths $K=6$ and target depths $L=3$, whereas existing estimators require 18 separate fits to evaluate the same $K \times L$ grid. On three systems with time-varying lag, ATEMPO is the only estimator to maintain perfect lag-detection accuracy across all evaluated window lengths. These recovered delays improve downstream forecasting: ATEMPO-selected inputs reduce MSE on WEATHER-5K by 7.25%, while 120 selected inputs outperform the benchmark's 240-feature default by 4.6%. Across three brain-computer interface tasks, using ATEMPO-selected lags achieves the highest or equal-best $R^2$, improving mean $R^2$ by 4.1% relative to the strongest competing baseline.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ATEMPO，用扩散模型构建按滞后与时间摊销的迁移熵估计器：训练时采样源与条件深度并显式条件于时间位置，单次拟合即可给出完整 TE 曲面，差分后检测信息到达延迟，并用于时序预测与脑机接口输入选择。
AI.relevance_reason: 迁移熵刻画源信息「何时」进入目标，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的到达时机、证据价值筛选与动态计算分配提供表述；其以滞后/深度为条件、单网络覆盖整个深度网格的摊销方式，可供核查是否对应 latent 步数与推理深度的长度泛化线索。
